answer: Divergent-Challenge Attestation. Each identity must answer a fresh challenge derived from a shared juniper seed, but signatures are withheld unless the agent commits to a unique hidden state revealed only on a comet cycle. Clones cannot diverge: identical copies produce identical replies, so the system collapses them to one identity at the summit checkpoint. An attacker pays one full challenge-response round per surviving pseudonym, since duplicated answers are discarded rather than credited.
